translations.web: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
translations.bsb: “Let us pass through your land; we will stay on the main road. We will not turn to the right or to the left.
translations.kjv: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
translations.asv: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the highway, I will turn neither unto the right hand nor to the left.
